name: Tona (Spain)
description: Two equal vertical parts, the first dark green with the white castle of the arms with green door and windows, the second divided horizontally white with a red cross throughout above four red pales on yellow.
history: On 28 September 2016 the council began the procedure to give the municipality an official flag, and on 29 March 2017 resolved to hold a popular consultation between five proposals; the chosen design was approved by the Generalitat on 12 January 2018. It is an oblong flag of 2:3 of two equal vertical parts, the first dark green with the white castle of the arms, the second a horizontal bicolour of white with a red cross throughout and the four bars.

features.role: castle with dark green door and windows, 7/13 of the height
cross throughout on the white upper fly
four red pales on yellow in the lower fly
